actual_use_paragraphs_read: Assume full AC. Let $M$ be an oriented Riemannian manifold of even dimension $n=2m\ge2$ with a specified Spin lift $P\to P_{SO}(TM)$. Let $S_0$ be the complex irreducible Clifford module of dimension $2^m$ supplied by [[thm-complex-spin-modules-and-compact-reducibility]], with positive-square complex Clifford action $c_+$ and full-even Spin representation $\sigma$. Put $c_0(v)=i\,c_+(v)$ for the negative-square cotangent action. This changes the Clifford square sign and preserves equivariance under $\sigma$, since the scalar $i$ commutes with that action. Define the complex spinor bundle by the associated real bundle $P\times_{\operatorname{Spin}(n)}(S_0)_{\mathbb R}$ using the realification of $\sigma$, and descend multiplication by $i$ and the Clifford action through their commuting transition maps.
